entities.name: Dark Barony
entities.description: The swampy lands of Baron Sengir on Ulgrotha, ruled from Castle Sengir, whose human inhabitants are kept under Sengir's rule and turned into undead on death.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Demon-like ruler of the Dark Barony who dominated the An-Zerrin and took over a Dwarven castle.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: Castle at the center of the Dark Barony, taken from the dwarves.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane where the Dark Barony lies.

entities.name: An-Zerrin
entities.description: Local peoples dominated by Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Sengir Autocrats
entities.description: Villagers chosen to pass on information and watch the villagers, with no real power.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: Lord of Koskun Keep who made a secret deal with the Baron.

entities.name: Koskun Keep
entities.description: Keep reached via a windy road out of the Barony.

events.summary: Stranded on the plane, Baron Sengir creates the barony, dominates the An-Zerrin and takes over a nearly completed Dwarven castle, driving the dwarves away.
events.quote: Baron Sengir created the barony when he was first stranded on the plane.

events.summary: Sengir has subjects kidnap people from Aysen and steals a vessel of thirty-one families to populate his land.
events.quote: He ordered his subjects to kidnap people from Aysen .

events.summary: Sengir sets a rule that for any who flee, ten others will be murdered.
events.quote: if one person tried to flee the Barony, the Baron would murder ten people in their place

events.summary: Eron and the Baron make a secret deal: Eron supplies the villagers while Sengir stops hostile actions against the Koskun Mountains.
events.quote: When Eron became lord of Koskun Keep, he and the Baron worked out a secret deal

relations.quote: The Dark Barony are the lands of Baron Sengir
